title: 第4章 我们已经没有关系了
slug: 前任渣我五年闪婚他哥被宠成宝
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

时夏禾坐了二十一路公交，按照纪枫发来的地址赶到江屿府时，刚好八点四十。

小区门口的保安拦住了她。

大概是有人提前打过招呼，对方核对完身份信息，很快便在门禁系统里录入了临时出入权限。

时夏禾道了谢，拖着行李箱往三号楼走。

江屿府是汉城出了名的高端住宅区，寸土寸金，随便一套房，都够普通人挣几辈子。

她长这么大，还是第一次进这种地方。

更没想过，有一天自己会住进来。

三号楼是六层洋房大平层，刷卡直达，入户就是独立玄关。

电梯到三楼停下。

时夏禾站在门前，攥着行李箱拉杆的手紧了紧，才抬手敲门。

门很快开了。

纪枫一身西装，神色依旧公事公办，开口时压低了声音。

“时小姐，先生还在休息，先小声一点。我带你认认屋子，你把东西收拾好。”

时夏禾下意识看了眼时间。

快九点了。

祁晏辞居然还没醒。

但她什么也没问，只点头：“好。”

纪枫带她简单走了一圈。

整套房子将近三百平，全屋极简冷调，浅灰大理石搭配原木软装，干净、空旷，也冷得没有半点烟火气。

主卧在最里面，旁边是医疗室，书房则单独锁着。

纪枫指了指那几扇门，语气郑重。

“书房、主卧、医疗室，没有先生允许，你不能进去。”

时夏禾记下。

“先生身体偶尔会不舒服，饮食忌口我发你手机上了。平时多留意，有事第一时间联系我。先生有需求，你照做就行。”

时夏禾点头：“我明白。”

纪枫接了个电话，很快便离开了。

时夏禾拖着箱子去了书房旁边的客房。

客房很大，比她之前那个十几平的出租屋宽敞太多，还有独立卫浴。

她却没有半点享受的心思。

收拾完，已经快中午十二点。

这期间，她出了房门好几次，可最里面那扇主卧门一直紧闭着。

祁晏辞始终没有出来。

时夏禾有些饿了，便去了厨房。

冰箱里食材很全。

纪枫发来的忌口也在手机里。

不吃重油重辣，不碰酒，少盐少糖，忌生冷。

时夏禾盯着那几行字看了会儿，心里大概有了数。

祁晏辞看起来冷得像冰，身体底子却未必有表面那么硬。

她没做复杂的。

清蒸鱼片，菌菇青菜汤，山药炒鸡丁。

三个菜都偏清淡，养胃，也不容易出错。

刚把最后一道菜端上桌，手机忽然响了。

时夏禾擦了擦手，接起电话。

那头传来闺蜜姜柠压低却藏不住震惊的声音。

Page (1/3)

Shi Xiahe took the No. 21 bus and arrived at Jiangyu Mansion according to the address Ji Feng sent. It was exactly 8:40.

The security guard at the gate of the community stopped her.

Someone probably said hello in advance. After checking the identity information, the other party quickly entered the temporary access rights into the access control system.

Shi Xiahe thanked him and dragged his suitcase to Building 3.

Jiangyu Mansion is a well-known high-end residential area in Seoul. Every inch of land and a single apartment can earn an ordinary person several lifetimes.

This is the first time in her life that she has entered such a place.

I never thought that one day I would live in it.

Building No. 3 is a six-storey bungalow with a large flat floor. It can be accessed directly by swiping a card, and the entrance is through an independent entrance.

The elevator stopped at the third floor.

Shi Xiahe stood in front of the door, clutching the suitcase handle tightly before raising his hand to knock on the door.

The door opened quickly.

Ji Feng was dressed in a suit, his expression was still businesslike, and he lowered his voice when he spoke.

"Miss Shi, sir, you are still resting, please keep your voice down for now. I will show you the house, and you can pack your things."

Shi Xiahe glanced at the time subconsciously.

It's almost nine o'clock.

Qi Yanci hasn't woken up yet.

But she didn't ask anything, just nodded: "Okay."

Ji Feng took her for a brief walk.

The entire house is nearly 300 square meters. The whole house is minimalist and cold-tempered, with light gray marble and log soft furnishings. It is clean, spacious, and so cold that there is no smoke or smoke.

The master bedroom is at the back, next to the medical room, and the study is locked separately.

Ji Feng pointed to the doors and spoke solemnly.

"The study, master bedroom, and medical room, you can't go in without sir's permission."

Shi Xiahe wrote it down.

"Sir, you may feel unwell from time to time. I will send you the dietary restrictions on your mobile phone. Pay more attention to it and contact me as soon as possible if you have any questions. If you need it, sir, just follow it."

Shi Xiahe nodded: "I understand."

Ji Feng answered the phone and left quickly.

Shi Xiahe dragged the box to the guest room next to the study.

The guest room is large, much more spacious than her previous rental house of more than ten square meters, and it also has an independent bathroom.

But she had no intention of enjoying it at all.

After cleaning up, it was almost noon.

During this period, she went out of the room several times, but the innermost master bedroom door was always closed.

Qi Yanci never came out.

Shi Xiahe was a little hungry, so he went to the kitchen.

The refrigerator is full of ingredients.

The taboo text sent by Ji Feng is also on the phone.

Avoid heavy oils and spicy foods, avoid alcohol, use less salt and less sugar, and avoid raw or cold foods.

Shi Xiahe stared at those lines of words for a while, and probably had an idea in his mind.

Qi Yanci looks as cold as ice, but his body may not be as hard as it appears.

She didn't do anything complicated.

Steamed fish fillet, mushroom and vegetable soup, fried diced chicken with yam.

All three dishes are on the light side, nourishing the stomach, and easy to make mistakes.

Just as the last dish was brought to the table, the phone suddenly rang.

Shi Xiahe wiped his hands and picked up the phone.

From the other end came the low but unable to hide shocked voice of my best friend Jiang Ning.
